codeSystems.name: LOINC
codeSystems.note: A subset: only the codes AMRIT binds to. The full release is not bundled.

codeSystems.name: WHONET antimicrobial codes
codeSystems.note: AMRIT's own code space, emitted alongside LOINC on every susceptibility result.

codeSystems.name: WHONET organism codes
codeSystems.note: AMRIT's own code space, emitted alongside SNOMED where licensed.

codeSystems.name: SNOMED CT
codeSystems.note: Only the concepts the WHONET catalogue references, with the descriptions the terminology server returned. Licensed content: free in a SNOMED International Member country, an affiliate licence elsewhere. Gated by code_systems.snomed.enabled, and omitted from output with a stated reason rather than substituted when it is off.

codeSystems.name: ICD-10
codeSystems.note: The starter value set only, verified against the terminology server. The full WHO release is not bundled; see docs/standards/TERMINOLOGY.md for the position and the reason.

codeSystems.name: ICD-11 for Mortality and Morbidity Statistics
codeSystems.note: A starter value set taken from WHO's own ICD API (release 2026-01), every code checked to exist *and* to carry the concept it was asked for. CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO: this is an unmodified subset of WHO's codes and titles, not a derivative. No ICD-10 to ICD-11 ConceptMap is generated — the API publishes no mapping between the revisions and inventing one would attach a guess to a diagnosis.

conceptMaps.note: Built by matching catalogue substance names to the LOINC ABXBACT class. The method variant is part of the target: an MIC and a disk result are different LOINC codes for the same drug.
The SNOMED codes the WHONET catalogue already carries. Gated by the deployment's SNOMED licence position, like every other SNOMED use here.
Only the specimen groups the catalogue codes. Five of eight carry no concept and are left unmapped rather than approximated.

valueSets.note: What the diagnosis picker offers first. It is the default value set, not the only codes a deployment may use.

The same clinical scope expressed in ICD-11 MMS, for a deployment whose records are on ICD-11. It is a parallel value set, not a translation: a record states which system its code came from and the two are never silently interchanged.
